COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

POSITION SUMMARY

KKR is growing our Global HRIS team and seeking a HRIS Analyst to support day to day HR systems operations across regions. This role offers an excellent opportunity to build foundational HR systems capability within a global HR technology environment. You will support HRIS operations, reporting, data integrity, and testing across Workday, ServiceNow, and Greenhouse, while contributing to projects that improve employee experience and operational efficiency. Working closely with HRIS colleagues in Dublin and Boston, as well as HR and Technology partners globally, you will play an important role in delivering scalable support and global coverage across the team.

TEAM OVERVIEW

KKR’s Global HRIS team is responsible for supporting and enhancing the firm’s core HR systems and technology platforms across regions. The team plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth operation, data integrity, and continuous improvement of systems such as Workday, ServiceNow, and Greenhouse.
Operating in a highly collaborative and globally distributed environment, the team partners closely with HR, Technology, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable solutions, maintain system accuracy, and enhance the employee experience while continuously improving organizational effectiveness and efficiency.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Support day to day HRIS operations, including processing standard requests and assisting with system updates under guidance.
• Use ServiceNow to log, track, and update HR requests and workflow cases, maintaining clear notes and handoffs.
• Monitor recurring issues, perform initial troubleshooting, and escalate complex or unresolved issues to senior team members.xecute data audits, support data quality checks, and help maintain system accuracy in Workday.
• Perform initial troubleshooting for Workday issues across modules such as HCM, Absence, and Time Tracking, resolving straightforward issues where guidance exists and escalating more complex issues appropriately.
• Assist with reporting by running standard and ad hoc Workday reports and contributing to requested report enhancements.
• Participate in testing activities for system changes, release deployment, and upgrades by executing scripts, logging defects, and validating fixes.
• Collaborate with HRIS colleagues across regions to document processes and contribute to knowledge management, including SOPs and job aids.
• Provide support to HR users and assist in resolving general system inquiries, including basic navigation of Workday and ServiceNow workflows.
• Support basic operational coordination with Greenhouse where needed (for example user support, data checks, and routing issues to the appropriate owner).
• Ability to manage routine operational work with accuracy, consistency, and strong attention to deadlines.

QUALIFICATIONS

• We are seeking candidates who have:
• 2 to 4 years of experience in HRIS support, or a related HR systems role with Workday.
• Strong analytical capabilities and attention to detail.
• Proficiency with Excel and data validation.
• Good communication and teamwork skills with an eagerness to learn.

jobs.description: Company description Saatchi & Saatchi is an advertising agency with the belief that creativity, data, media and technology should all work together, and we use that to influence human behavior and drive success for clients. S&S is one of the world's largest agency networks with 114 offices and more than 6000 employees globally. Here in our Toronto office we work with some of the countries most valued brands including Toyota, Buckley's, and Children's Advil, as well as several under the Mondelez banner (Crispers, Oreo, and Chips Ahoy just to name a few). We’re an award winning agency in both creativity and effectiveness, so it’s really important for us here to convert that innovation and the great ideas into real tangible business results for the organization. Overview Saatchi & Saatchi is seeking a Senior Digital/Technical Project Manager for an innovative AI platform initiative starting immediately. We are looking for someone with a producer's mindset — the instincts of a VFX producer, game producer, or hands-on product owner — paired with strong technical fluency, who thrives in a fast-paced environment. You translate between engineering, design, business, and clients, and you build and carry the mental model of what the platform is, what it needs next, and how every piece relates. You operate calmly in a fast-moving multi-stakeholder environment that spans agencies, holding-company partners, and global Publicis teams. This is a full-time (40h/week), 12-month contract position. Responsibilities Hold and maintain the technical mental model of the platform — what is built, what is being built, what is needed, and how every component relates to the broader program — and act as a trusted translator between engineering, design, leadership, and clients. Provide technical thought leadership and partner with engineering and architecture on what the product actually needs next, not just what is on the backlog. Plan, sequence, and drive delivery across multiple concurrent workstreams (frontend, backend, agentic, data, infra) and across multiple environments and live release events. Run a lightweight, high-signal agile cadence — standups, planning, retros — that respects engineering focus time and produces decisions, not status theatre. Track and communicate scope, dependencies, risk, and progress across Saatchi, Moov AI, Publicis NA, and global Publicis stakeholders. Act as the primary point of coordination for technical readiness around live events (Builder Nights, integration milestones, client demos), driving pre-event run-throughs and post-event retros. Identify scope creep, conflicting priorities, and unowned work early — and either resolve them, escalate them, or absorb the coordination cost so engineering can keep shipping. Maintain just-enough living documentation (system overviews, decision logs, release notes) so the team's mental model can survive a hire, a departure, or a vacation. Represent the technical reality of the program in client and leadership conversations — translating engineering trade-offs into language that lands. Qualifications Demonstrated track record running complex technical programs end-to-end — software platforms, AI/ML products, large web implementations, complex digital productions, or equivalent. Years are flexible; depth and judgement are not. Good technical fluency: you can sit in an architecture conversation about microservices, APIs, cloud infrastructure, or LLM/agent systems and add real value, not just take notes. Experience coordinating cross-functional delivery across engineering, design, QA, data, infra, and external vendors or partners. Comfortable working in agile, hybrid-agile, or producer-led delivery models, and choosing the right cadence for the moment. Strong stakeholder management across technical and non-technical audiences — clients, executives, engineers, designers, holding-company partners. Hands-on with modern collaboration and PM tooling (Jira, Confluence, Loop / Notion, Miro / FigJam, GitHub, Slack / Teams). Working understanding of modern cloud-native platforms, CI/CD, and AI/LLM-enabled products — enough to ask the right questions and challenge soft answers. Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to summarize a chaotic situation into a clear next-action paragraph. Located in or willing to work Toronto hours; hybrid presence expected for client and team moments. Required Soft Skills Producer instincts — you treat shipping as the goal, you protect the team from churn, and you measure success by what got delivered. Pattern-recognition under noise — you can hold a complex live picture in your head and notice when something is drifting before it breaks. Calm under pressure — live events, infrastructure surprises, and stakeholder escalations don't rattle your communication. Translator's ear — you can paraphrase engineering accurately to a client and paraphrase client intent accurately to engineering, without losing fidelity. Bias to action — you would rather make a reversible call now than hold a meeting to ratify the obvious one. Comfortable with chaos and ambiguity, but committed to leaving the program more legible than you found it. Generous with credit, direct with concerns, professional in conflict. Nice to Have Prior experience in a Publicis Groupe or other major holding-company agency environment (cultural shorthand transfers fast). Background as a VFX producer, game producer, technical product owner, or hands-on technical solutions consultant. Experience producing or coordinating live demo / launch events with real users on a non-rehearsable schedule. Exposure to AI/LLM-enabled product delivery (agents, RAG, evaluation loops, prompt iteration cycles). PMI-ACP, CSM, or comparable agile certification (signal, not a gate). Familiarity with GCP / GKE, contract-first integration models, or multi-tenant SaaS delivery patterns. Additional information Location & Eligibility: Candidates must be based in Canada, with valid Canadian work authorization of at least 12 months. Hybrid Work: This role is remote. If you are GTA-based, the team meets once a month at our Toronto office (111 Queen St. E, Suite 200, Toronto, ON M5C 1S2), with possible occasional travel to meet stakeholders (Montreal, NY, London). Time Off: - Up to 3 weeks vacation, with additional paid closure between Christmas and New Year's - Extended long weekends for provincial holidays — we give you both the Monday and Friday so you get a full 4-day break - 10 personal days per year Flexibility & Global Mobility: After completing one year, work remotely for up to 6 weeks per year from any of our 50+ global offices through our Work Your World program. Benefits: Comprehensive group coverage including: - Medical, dental, and vision care - Psychological and paramedical services - Disability insurance Parental Leave Top up: A 100% salary top up program once approved for Employment Insurance for the first 6 weeks of your parental Leave. Gym Membership: Corporate Membership rates at Good Life Fitness Free access to a financial planner & more… Compensation: The salary range for this position is $70,000–$100,000 per year, based on experience, skills, and relevant certifications. We believe in pay transparency and are committed to offering competitive, market-aligned compensation. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as reviewing applications or analyzing resumes. These tools assist our recruitment team but never replace human decision-making. We believe in a human-first approach, where your experience and potential are recognized by people. Saatchi & Saatchi is committed to building a diverse workforce representative of our community. jobs.description: Role Purpose The Legal Compliance Lead Analyst supports Cigna International Health’s global privacy program and serves as the designated in-country representative of the Chief International Privacy Officer in engagements with competent data protection and other relevant authorities in India. The role combines privacy advisory expertise with disciplined, process and project driven delivery across core privacy operations. The role partners with business, Legal, Compliance, Information Protection and other relevant functions, acts within defined governance and escalation frameworks, and promptly escalates complex, high-risk or material regulatory matters to the International Privacy Officer referent. Key Responsibilities 1. Regulatory representation and governance Act as the designated representative of the International Privacy Officer in communications and engagements with competent data protection and other relevant authorities in India, within formally delegated authority and approved positions. Coordinate regulatory enquiries, information requests, meetings and follow-up actions, maintaining complete and accurate records and escalating material, sensitive or high-risk matters without delay. Monitor relevant privacy and data protection developments in India and contribute to the development of legal expertise for strategic markets. Support governance reporting, including the annual data protection report, management updates and evidence required for oversight. Own and drive global, cross-jurisdictional International Privacy Office projects end to end, engaging directly with internal stakeholders as needed to move work forward without requiring escalation of routine coordination. 2. Privacy advisory and risk assessments Act as a data protection subject matter expert for the business, providing practical advice on privacy issues and cross-border matters. Lead or support Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), Transfer Impact Assessments (TIAs) and periodic reviews, ensuring that decisions, risks, mitigations and approvals are documented. Identify potential data protection issues and opportunities for improvement, and contribute to structural, procedural and policy enhancements. Identify matters requiring specialist legal, security or executive input and apply defined escalation protocols. Conduct and progress AI assessments, reviewing respondent submissions, applying risk-tiering and classification criteria, aligning DPIA conclusions with AI Assessment findings, and advancing initiatives through the approval workflow. 3. Core privacy operations Oversee and support the processing of Data Subject Rights requests using approved workflows, templates, intake channels, ticketing and tracking tools. Maintain privacy registers, logs, trackers, review schedules and closure records, with a strong focus on quality, consistency and auditability. Coordinate the administrative handling of personal data breaches and privacy incidents, working with Information Protection and relevant stakeholders. Support shared privacy mailbox management and ensure that requests are triaged, assigned, tracked and closed appropriately. 4. Privacy framework, records and compliance monitoring Support the implementation and maintenance of Records of Processing Activities (ROPA) for controller and processor activities. Ensure that privacy policies, guidelines and procedures are defined, implemented, periodically reviewed and kept current. Test and monitor compliance with applicable privacy requirements, including relevant Indian requirements and, where applicable to International Health activities, GDPR, UK, DIFC, Asian, Middle Eastern and African data protection frameworks. Support audit readiness through evidence collection, document organization, implementation tracking and remediation follow-up. 5. Vendor, contracting and cross-border support Conduct or oversee first-pass privacy reviews of vendor questionnaires and due diligence documentation, and coordinate the escalation of non-standard or high-risk issues. Support the Legal team in drafting and negotiating internal and external privacy terms, including Standard Contractual Clauses where applicable. Coordinate contract intake, routing, records and follow-up, and support approved template-based privacy clauses. Advise on privacy considerations associated with international data transfers and cross-border processing. 6. Consent, training, reporting and continuous improvement Support cookie and consent management activities and maintain records of implementation status. Develop privacy training and awareness content for relevant employees and support delivery of targeted awareness initiatives. About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are seeking a Public Sector Account Executive to drive the adoption of safe, frontier AI across governments in Southeast Asia, establishing and growing Anthropic's presence in this strategic region. Based in Singapore, you'll leverage your consultative sales expertise and deep understanding of public sector landscapes across ASEAN markets to grow revenue while becoming a trusted partner to government customers, helping them embed and deploy AI and uncover its full range of capabilities. Working with ministries, statutory boards, and agencies across the region, you'll navigate diverse procurement, security, and compliance environments to build long-term strategic partnerships. In collaboration with GTM, product, policy, and marketing teams, you'll help define our market entry strategy and value proposition for public sector customers across ASEAN.

Key responsibilities

• Lead Anthropic's market entry and expansion across ASEAN public sector markets, building relationships with key stakeholders across ministries, statutory boards, and government agencies in Singapore and throughout the region
• Own the full sales cycle for public sector opportunities across ASEAN, from initial outreach through to successful deployment, with a focus on building long-term strategic partnerships
• Navigate the procurement requirements, security standards, and compliance frameworks specific to government technology adoption in each market—including GeBIZ procurement and IM8 security requirements in Singapore—and prioritise markets based on opportunity and readiness
• Collaborate with policy teams to ensure alignment with national AI strategies and digital government initiatives across the region, such as Singapore's National AI Strategy and Smart Nation programme and the ASEAN Guide on AI Governance and Ethics
• Design and execute sales strategies tailored to each public sector environment, meeting and exceeding revenue targets while maintaining strong relationships with procurement teams and decision-makers
• Provide market intelligence and feedback to product teams to ensure our offerings meet regional public sector requirements, including data sovereignty, data residency, and localisation considerations that vary by country
• Build and maintain relationships with systems integrators, in-country partners, and technology partners across ASEAN markets
• Develop and document best practices for public sector engagement in each market, creating playbooks that scale our presence across the region
• Serve as a leader within the broader public sector team, sharing insights and collaborating on cross-market opportunities

Minimum qualifications

• 12+ years of enterprise sales experience in public sector markets across ASEAN, with a proven track record of driving adoption of emerging technologies
• Deep understanding of government procurement processes, security requirements, and technology adoption frameworks in Singapore (including GeBIZ and IM8), and familiarity with equivalent frameworks in other ASEAN markets
• Strong track record of managing complex sales cycles and securing strategic deals in the public sector
• Experience navigating multiple stakeholders across ministries and agencies in culturally diverse markets, building consensus and providing innovative solutions
• Experience working with in-country partners and channel ecosystems to reach markets where direct presence is limited
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to present confidently to all levels, from technical teams to senior government officials
• Eligibility to handle classified government information as required
• Ability to work independently while maintaining strong collaboration with global teams, with willingness to travel regularly across the region
• Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience

Preferred qualifications

• Experience working with agencies such as GovTech, and familiarity with national digital transformation initiatives across the region
• Demonstrated ability to build and grow new market segments across multiple countries, with potential to develop into a leadership role
• Strategic thinking combined with hands-on execution capabilities
• Proficiency in a regional language beyond English
• A passion for safe and ethical AI development, with the ability to articulate its importance in the public sector context

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. ABOUT THE TEAM

The Statsig team within OpenAI builds the experimentation, feature rollout, dynamic configuration, and analytics systems that help OpenAI ship products with speed, safety, and evidence. Our work sits on the critical path for how product, engineering, research, and go-to-market teams learn from real-world usage and make high-confidence decisions.

Statsig began as an independent company focused on helping builders move faster through trustworthy experimentation and feature management. After Statsig joined OpenAI, the team began the next chapter: bringing that deep product expertise, customer intuition, and mature platform infrastructure into OpenAI as the experimentation and rollout platform for every product we ship.

Today, we support teams across ChatGPT, Codex, model measurement, consumer experiences including ads, business subscriptions, developer products, and the shared infrastructure that connects them. These teams rely on Statsig to safely introduce new capabilities, compare product and model behavior, measure impact, and roll changes forward or back with confidence.

We are at a defining moment in the platform journey. OpenAI has the data, product surface area, and pace of innovation to learn faster than almost any organization in the world, but that potential only becomes real if teams can experiment responsibly, measure clearly, and roll out changes safely. Adoption of the platform is accelerating rapidly across the company, and recent SDK and server-side infrastructure work has already produced measurable wins in latency, reliability, memory usage, and compute efficiency for important services.

Based out of OpenAI’s Bellevue office, we are a close-knit team that values in-person collaboration, urgency, craft, and impact. We build for other builders, and the best version of this team is one where every OpenAI product team can move faster because the experimentation and rollout layer is dependable, fast, and easy to use.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a full-stack engineer to help build the systems that make experimentation and rollout a first-class capability across OpenAI. You will work across frontend, backend, SDK, data, and infrastructure surfaces, with a focus on making complex workflows feel simple for the teams shipping OpenAI’s most important products.

This role is not only about adding features to a platform. It is about shaping the operating system OpenAI uses to decide what to launch, how to learn from it, and how to protect users and products as we scale. OpenAI’s next phase depends on our ability to move quickly without losing rigor, and Statsig is one of the places where that balance becomes real.

You will collaborate closely with teams building ChatGPT, Codex, model measurement workflows, consumer monetization and ads, business subscription experiences, developer products, and shared infrastructure. You will translate their launch and measurement needs into platform capabilities that can support the full company, not just one-off use cases.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

- Build product experiences and platform capabilities for experimentation, feature flags, dynamic configuration, rollout safety, and analytics.

- Partner with product teams to understand launch workflows, measurement needs, and decision points, then turn those insights into durable platform features.

- Improve SDK and server-side systems so experimentation and configuration are fast, reliable, and safe for high-scale OpenAI services.

- Help teams across ChatGPT, Codex, model measurement, ads, business subscriptions, developer products, and infrastructure use Statsig effectively.

- Design workflows that make it easier to create experiments, interpret results, monitor rollouts, and act quickly when a launch needs adjustment.

- Contribute to the technical direction of a platform that must support rapid adoption, high availability, and increasingly sophisticated product and model evaluation needs.

- Work from the Bellevue office with a team that values ownership, clear communication, and high-trust collaboration.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

- Have strong full-stack engineering judgment and enjoy building product surfaces that sit on top of serious platform and infrastructure constraints.

- Care deeply about developer experience and can make powerful experimentation concepts feel intuitive to busy product teams.

- Are excited by the post-acquisition chapter of a high-performing team: preserving what made Statsig strong while integrating deeply into OpenAI’s product development system.

- Like working on systems where performance, reliability, and product quality all matter at the same time.

- Can move between customer conversations, product design, backend architecture, SDK behavior, and data-informed decision making.

- Want your work to influence how OpenAI ships across ChatGPT, Codex, model measurement, consumer monetization, business products, and future product surfaces.

- Value in-person collaboration and want to help shape a growing Bellevue-based team.

LOCATION AND WORKPLACE

This role is based in Bellevue, Washington. The team works in person and uses that time to move quickly, solve ambiguous problems together, and stay close to the product teams we support.
